trigger: Child scores below mastery threshold on sound identification.
strategy: Replay with only two choices, use familiar sounds, and remove visual distractors. Then try 3 new items.
Start with identical sounds versus very different sounds, then increase similarity.
Use clearly contrasted recordings and a simple loud/soft visual scale, keeping volume safe.
Use exaggerated fast/slow patterns with an equal number of sounds.
Return to 2-sound sequences, then increase to 3 only after success.

trigger: Child does not attend to the ending sound when comparing words.
strategy: Use picture pairs with very obvious rhymes.

trigger: Child does not attend to the first sound when comparing words.
strategy: Isolate and exaggerate the first sound before the whole word, use just two very different starting sounds, then reintroduce a wider set.
